pathAssistantSteps.info:
Qualify the opportunity during the meeting.

  • Confirm the client, decision maker, service needed, and primary pain points.
  • Record the completed meeting time and agree on a clear next step.
  • Do not advance until the client need and follow-up owner are clear.

Send a complete proposal and establish follow-up.

  • Verify the service scope, pricing, and expected deliverables.
  • Record when the proposal was sent.
  • Set the next step for client review and follow-up.

Resolve objections and confirm the path to signature.

  • Confirm discovery is complete and budget is approved.
  • Keep pricing and the expected start date current.
  • Document the next decision or action required from the client.

Drive the contract and payment to completion.

  • Confirm the contract was sent to the correct signer.
  • Verify the checkout link, amount, and expected start date.
  • Track the next follow-up until signature and payment are complete.

Complete the handoff to onboarding and delivery.

  • Confirm payment and contract completion before closing the deal.
  • Link the Store and CSM Call, and verify Seller ID and SPN access.
  • Ensure onboarding ownership and the expected end date are recorded.

Document why the opportunity was lost.

  • Select a specific loss reason and add useful context to the description.
  • Confirm the final amount and date for reporting.
  • Record a next step only when future re-engagement is appropriate.
